notes.title: FHM7 Update 7.5.145 Now Available
notes.content:
This will be the final major update for FHM7 - if we discover any new serious problems after this release, we'll deal with them in a hotfix as usual, but this will be the last update that adds a significant amount of new content to the game.  (If you find any problems with this update, particularly fixes that aren't working or unexpected issues arising out of the changes made, please report them the usual channels - preferably the tech support forum on our boards, the Steam board, or /r/franchisehockey on Reddit, those get checked daily.)  We'll now be moving on to full-time development of FHM8, which will hopefully release at something closer to our usual October release this time around; we've already started on that and are making good progress at adding some new and exciting things to the game.

Your existing savegames will be compatible with the updated game, but some of the update's fixes may not retroactively correct certain problems in existing saves.

[b]New Features:[/b]

-added injury frequency options to File-Setup/Options, with options for fewer/very few/almost no/no injuries; can be adjusted in mid-game
-new functions added to multiplayer leagues on the Setup/Options-Online League screen: Creating and uploading the league files (with two options, the "complete" version includes graphics, "basic" doesn't) and Downloading and updating the league files
-added 10 new Historical Challenges (with accompanying achievements)
-added a "SIM" button beside the VIEW button on the league schedule screen, that sims the game without needing to open the pregame screen to use the SIM GAME button there
-added new set of advanced stats, viewable in the Advanced (2) option of the stats dropdown for roster-type screens: zone starts, shootout stats, and 3-star selections
-the autoplay standings (and the league-standings screen) now shows preseason player stats leaders during the preseason, then switches to regular season leaders once that begins
-added a ratings filter to the staff filter
-Tournament games now appear on team schedules with a light green background, overriding the usual blue home/red away
-added the ability to select the template on the "Create Player" option (using the template names on the player edit screen)
-addition to the new scounting reports: in standard and custom games (i.e. not historical) if the team is in a league that has any drafts with a minimum age >17, a section is added that lists the top 5 players (ranked by their potential as viewed by the team) eligible for each of those drafts in the next 3 seasons after the current one, e.g. while playing in the NHL in 20-21 it'll show the top 5 players for the 2022, 2023, and 2024 NHL Entry Drafts, listed as "Projected Top Picks for (Season) (Draft Name):"
-"Last Day for Contract Renewals/Qualifying Offers" added to the league events list on June 30 for all leagues
-user can now edit the uniform numbers of players on any team when commissioner mode is on
-the injury list counter is now editable in commissioner mode
-suspension length is now editable in the Status section of the player edit screen
-on the development reports, after the player's age the current league-relative (to the team owning the development report) talent and potential have been added, e.g. "C John Smith (27, 3.0/4.0), Chicago Blackhawks (NHL)"
-added a ROW column to the standings screens between DIFF and HOME (Regulation and Overtime Wins, used as a standings tiebreaker)
-added a dropdown to the team transaction log that filters the list by each specific transaction type
-AI-run European teams will now give a foreign player it wants to send to its farm team the option of mutually terminating the contract instead
-when starting a new historical game in the seasons 1972-1978, if a player on a WHA team has any NHL teams in his career history, his NHL rights are now set to the NHL team he played for last
-added an additional Historical editing checkbox to Manager Options: "Schedule Lengths: Leagues" will change their season lengths when they did historically if this is checked (i.e. the league schedule length will be updated from the database on July 1 (if there's no entry for the league for that season, e.g. if the user let the WHA continue after 1979, it won't change)
-the awards ceremony screen now lists the award nominees in they grey square before revealing the winner
-added text to Tactical Settings descriptions to describe specifing positioning of players where it deviates from a normal positioning setup (e.g. which forwards is the deep forechecker in a 1-1-3)
-current database updated to post-NHL trading deadline status (it's a little later than we've done in previous years, about a week after the deadline, which in particular gets a few more of the late NHL signings in)

[b]Other Fixes and Changes:[/b]

-fixed crash when using the "Clear A" button on the team scouting watch list under some circumstances
-in multiplayer games, the AI will no longer override human-selected protected lists for waiver/intraleague drafts
-made another modification to scouting priority mechanics for junior leagues to place players outside the team's region but in the same nation at the bottom of the queue
-the new section of the scouting report that's supposed to show the top free agents/available players at the team's weakness appears no longer shows them for the team's strengths instead
-shifted weighting of stat-adjusted talent for F/D to emphasize scoring more at the expense of game rating
-fixed a few issues in the world database, mainly in non-hockey countries, that were resulting in some cities being listed as part of the wrong country
-the back button should now work normally when navigating within international tournament histories, i.e. clicking back won't return you to a blank page in some places
-the World Menu's Tournaments section now defaults to the Olympic tournament unless the user has previously selected another tournament (previously, there was no default, so if you wentto standings at the start of the game it would point to the NHL playoffs)
-if the user creates a custom league with an initial draft and then expands the league before the draft, the expansion teams will now take part in the draft and won't sign players on July 1 before they can be drafted
-while viewing the Info tab of a club team's team page, if you then use the World menu to switch to a national team and then click on one of the other sub-tabs on that screen (e.g. Team Data) tab, you no longer get a mixture of national team and club data
-autoplay standings screen no longer shows the previous's seasons GAA and Save % leaders from July 1 to the preseason
-if a player has a minor (orange) injury, he will now be sorted properly along with the other players when clicking on the fitness column of the roster screen
-removed redundant "player returned from the injury list" popup
-adjusted mock draft criteria again to weight current ability and overall potential more highly
-the scouting update message no longer uses the language of the user's Windows setup to show the month, instead of the English month name
-added minimum language acquisition speed for all players, should prevent players from never learning a language despite remaining in a country for a long time
-teams on the Team-Transactions-Transaction Summary screen are now sorted alphabetically
-AI should now handle goalies better during the preseason, calling up any goalies it has on the farm that are better than the ones on the current roster (and thereby not exposing them to season-start waivers)
-fixed the ES AT, PP AT, and SH AT amounts on the player screen-season stats tab-third "Split" section
-at 1600x900 (fullscreen), the "Next International" line on the team home page no longer gets partially cut off at the bottom
-on the postgame screen, in the Injuries section at the bottom, if there are a lot of injuries the list will they now wrap around instead of continuing past the right edge of the box
-in boxscore_period_penalties_summary.csv and boxscore_period_scoring_summary.csv, OT period numbers are now specified
-the "Players playing against their former team" and "Players visiting their hometown" fields in the game preview screen's pregame notes section should now display proper results instead of always being "None"
-on the League-League Home screen, the Transactions tab now lists trades and waiver claims in addition to signings
-fixed issue with 2021 draft picks being tradeable after the draft in some circumstances
-with historical editing turned on and the team activation option selected, expansion drafts will now occur as they did historically instead of requiring that you re-add them manually
-added icons for the following awards after the player's name on his profile screen: Sportsmanship Award, Player's MVP Award, Leadership Award, Dedication Award
-in leagues where ties are possible, the standings screen now shows the OTL column as T
-in team-scouting, with the "Hire Scouts" screen open, clicking on an individual scout to see their profile and then pressing the back button to return to the map will no longer change the map to show 0.3 (red) in all regions
-changed the default sort order on World-National Data-Nation Profile to Population (descending)
-if a player is restricted from signing by the Iron Curtain rule, he will not be shown in the list of eligible players to be selected during the draft
-lowered the effect games played has on Goalie Stat-Adjusted Talent
-in the player screen history tab, mock draft results are no longer off by 1, e.g. #1 was shown as #0
-the CHL import draft order should now be calculated correctly, and rotate picks between leagues (requires new game)
-on the contract negotiation screen, one of the salary amounts is no longer shown in $US even if the currency symbol has been changed
-on the depth chart screen, right-clicking one of the Right Wings will no longer shift all the players to the left, cutting off the first letter of the goalies' names
-clicking on a player's name in the training screen now opens his profile
-adjusted goalie development to significantly reduce the chances of them exceeding their potential, which was happening much too often
-removed the 2021 Memorial Cup from the real 20-21 start now that it has been officially cancelled
-corrected a small data interpretation problem in historical that was resulting in some players starting as free agents instead of with their correct team
-the team-roster-contracts tab will now have a default sort the same as the active roster unless the user has changed it
-if a player's contract is edited to be an ELC, the contract created no longer ends in UFA status for the player
-with the draft off in historical mode, players who are added to their historical team on July 1 of their first season should now have their league rights assigned properly instead of being set to None
-in the postgame notes section of the postgame screen, all unused players will be listed, not just the visiting goalie
-in historical games, players who begin the game retired no longer have an entry in their highlights that they retired on January 1, 1900
-the Hall of Fame should now work properly again in historical mode
-in the pregame notes section of the game preview screen in leagues where games can end in a tie, the coach's record is no longer shown with the ties missing
-the "Auto-Play to Event..." options for the Awards Ceremony and Intra-League draft are now no longer shown until the league's season ends, since the dates of those are dependent on the date the season ends and the date shown at the start of the season will be inaccurate
-the "Set to Inactive" option in the league structure editor is now disabled in historical (had been left on unintentionally, but turning a league off like that will lead to extreme instability in historical mode)
-AI should now skip picks more often during waiver and intraleague drafts
-when generating/regenerating a league schedule, if trading/transfer deadlines are are later than 30 days before the final date of the regenerated schedule, they'll be moved to 30 days before the end date
-hitting the space bar now continues the game properly while on the free agent centre screen
-adjusted AI's behaviour when choosing goalies for protected lists (expansion/waiver/intraleague drafts) so it chooses low-ability, high- (or even middle-) potential goalies over established ones
-special characters (e.g. umlaut) should now appear properly in the text of the contract negotiation screen
-Regina Historical Challenge is now successful after a WCHL playoff championship, as originally intdended
-decreased AI's tendency to pick up marginal players on waivers
-fixed issue with team editing that would make it impossible for user control of farm lines to work on newly-created teams
-fixed crash that could result when a team is deactivated before removing its farm team affiliations; this will auto-fix games with the existing problems
-fixed numerous players showing up as free agents in a 2004-05 historical start when they should have been on a team
-the Hall of Fame announcement screen no longer ignores post-game-start championship wins
-"Replace With" now works properly on a farm team when the user is managing its parent has the control lines option on
-adjusted role scores for enforcer, goon, and agitator roles so players who fight frequently will score higher in the first two and lower in the third 
-fixed a crash when right-clicking on a player's name under some circumstances
-the talent/potential numbers that were added to the development reports now appear for players who have attribute decreases as well as the ones who improved
-the AI will no longer refuse to trade players they acquired recently, but have put on the trading block
-added a 3-star points total to Stats: Advanced (awarded on a 5-3-1 basis for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd stars, respectively)
-3-star selections in Stats: Advanced (2) are now recorded properly for goalies
-added tooltips for the new Advanced (2) stat columns
-fixed potential lineup data updating issue in multiplayer games that could cause a crash during game simulation
-changing a team name and abbreviation on July 1 no longer changes the name in all previous years in the draft log
-the InD (injury days lost) column on Leagues-Stats-Team Stats now properly counts days lost to injuries that were added by editing a player 
-the Memorial Cup in custom games will now no longer function if any of the 3 CHL leagues have been deactivated (rather than crashing when it attempts to schedule the tournament)

[b]2D Mode Changes:[/b]

-added multiple view zoom options to 2D, including one that shows the whole ice surface ("Fit to screen")
-added support for a separate goalie icon with a "goalie" (rather than "player") prefix , e.g. if goalie_chicago_blackhawks_home.png exists, it will be used for the goalie instead of player_chicago_blackhawks_home.png
-sped up player movement towards the bench on a line change
-offensive non-puckhandlers' movement should now be a little more forward-directed during breakouts and in the neutral zone (it had a tendency to to a little too side-to-side, which was creating problems when the puckhandler was usually getting well ahead of his wingers/rushing D)
-defencemen on the puckhandling team no longer worry about covering opponents who are lingering so far behind the play as to be a non-factor in a potential turnover situation 
-players should now move correctly during shot attempts, instead of the odd pause they were taking while the shot moved
-made some rebalancing moves to get stats back into their proper ranges after the previous changes to gameplay distorted them, particularly shooting percentage, shot attempts, hits, and fights

notes.title: Open Beta for Final Update
notes.content:
For the upcoming update, we're once again going to run a public beta for a week or so prior to the official release, giving you access to test builds of the new update before we finalize things.  Last time wasn't a perfect success, as some things still slipped through and forced a hotfix, but we did manage to get several useful changes in.  In particular, we'd like multiplayer leagues to do some testing of the new in-game file-handling functions (but please do so with backups of your existing leagues, lest something go horribly wrong.)

[b]Please bear in mind, if you opt-in to the beta, that these are test builds and may do unexpected things[/b]; the whole point of the public beta is to find these problems.  We offer no promises that something unpleasant won't happen to any save you use with the beta version, so, if you want to take part with one of your current saved games, it's best to use the "Save Game As" option on the game's File menu to make a new version of the save and use that, so you don't ruin the "good" copy of your save.

Right now we're aiming for a full release of the update sometime next week, but that plan could change depending on how long it takes to resolve any issues found in the beta and any new ones that come up.

The public beta is only available for the Steam version of the game - Steam makes it ridiculously easy to set one up (under an hour for Sebastian and I the first time we do it, minutes afterward), where a Fastspring beta would require a full-scale release process from us (most of a day for Malte and Sebastian every time we update the beta), which isn't practical to do.

[b]To join the beta:

1. Right-click on FHM7 in your Steam Library and select Properties
2. Click on "Betas"
3. Under "Enter beta access code to unlock private betas", enter the access code, which is "updatepublicbeta" (no quotes)
4. That should populate the "Select the beta..." box above with the option "public_beta - Public Beta", select that
5. Steam should then automatically update your game.  If it doesn't do that, check your update queue; if it's not in there, exit and restart the Steam client and it should appear.[/b]

Should you wish to leave the beta, just go back to the Betas page and on the dropdown menu select None.  Steam will then revert you to the current public version of the game.  When the final version of the update is ready, the public beta branch will be updated to that one as well, so there'll be no need to change back to get it.

If you're already one of our internal beta testers, don't join the public beta!  You'll lose access to the beta versions we don't release to the public.

If you find any problems with the beta, particularly fixes that aren't working or unexpected issues arising out of the changes made, continue to report them the usual channels - preferably the tech support forum on our boards, the Steam board, or /r/franchisehockey on Reddit, those get checked daily.  But, when reporting, please mention that you found the problem while using the public beta.

-new functions added to multiplayer leagues on the Setup/Options-Online League screen: Creating and uploading the league files (with two options, the "complete" version includes graphics, "basic" doesn't) and Downloading and updating the league files

-added a ratings filter to the staff filter

-the injury list counter is now editable in commissioner mode
-suspension length is now editable in the Status section of the player edit screen
-on the development reports, after the player's age the current league-relative (to the team owning the development report) talent and potential have been added, e.g. "C John Smith (27, 3.0/4.0), Chicago Blackhawks (NHL)"

-added a dropdown to the team transaction log that filters the list by each specific transaction type
-AI-run European teams will now give a foreign player it wants to send to its farm team the option of mutually terminating the contract instead
-when starting a new historical game in the seasons 1972-1978, if a player on a WHA team has any NHL teams in his career history, his NHL rights are now set to the NHL team he played for last
-added an additional Historical editing checkbox to Manager Options: "Schedule Lengths: Leagues" will change their season lengths when they did historically if this is checked (i.e. the league schedule length will be updated from the database on July 1 (if there's no entry for the league for that season, e.g. if the user let the WHA continue after 1979, it won't change)
-the awards ceremony screen now lists the award nominees in they grey square before revealing the winner
-added text to Tactical Settings descriptions to describe specifing positioning of players where it deviates from a normal positioning setup (e.g. which forwards is the deep forechecker in a 1-1-3)

-fixed crash when using the "Clear A" button on the team scouting watch list under some circumstances
-in multiplayer games, the AI will no longer override human-selected protected lists for waiver/intraleague drafts
-made another modification to scouting priority mechanics for junior leagues to place players outside the team's region but in the same nation at the bottom of the queue
-the new section of the scouting report that's supposed to show the top free agents/available players at the team's weakness appears no longer shows them for the team's strengths instead
-shifted weighting of stat-adjusted talent for F/D to emphasize scoring more at the expense of game rating
-fixed a few issues in the world database, mainly in non-hockey countries, that were resulting in some cities being listed as part of the wrong country
-the back button should now work normally when navigating within international tournament histories, i.e. clicking back won't return you to a blank page in some places

-if the user creates a custom league with an initial draft and then expands the league before the draft, the expansion teams will now take part in the draft and won't sign players on July 1 before they can be drafted

-removed redundant "player returned from the injury list" popup
-adjusted mock draft criteria again to weight current ability and overall potential more highly
-the scouting update message no longer uses the language of the user's Windows setup to show the month, instead of the English month name

-teams on the Team-Transactions-Transaction Summary screen are now sorted alphabetically
-AI should now handle goalies better during the preseason, calling up any goalies it has on the farm that are better than the ones on the current roster (and thereby not exposing them to season-start waivers)

-in boxscore_period_penalties_summary.csv and boxscore_period_scoring_summary.csv, OT period numbers are now specified
-the "Players playing against their former team" and "Players visiting their hometown" fields in the game preview screen's pregame notes section should now display proper results instead of always being "None"
-on the League-League Home screen, the Transactions tab now lists trades and waiver claims in addition to signings
-fixed issue with 2021 draft picks being tradeable after the draft in some circumstances
-with historical editing turned on and the team activation option selected, expansion drafts will now occur as they did historically instead of requiring that you re-add them manually
-added icons for the following awards after the player's name on his profile screen: Sportsmanship Award, Player's MVP Award, Leadership Award, Dedication Award
-in leagues where ties are possible, the standings screen now shows the OTL column as T

-adjusted AI's behaviour when choosing goalies for protected lists (expansion/waiver/intraleague drafts) so it chooses low-ability, high- (or even middle-) potential goalies over established ones
-special characters (e.g. umlaut) should now appear properly in the text of the contract negotiation screen

-decreased AI's tendency to pick up marginal players on waivers
-fixed issue with team editing that would make it impossible for user control of farm lines to work on newly-created teams
-fixed crash that could result when a team is deactivated before removing its farm team affiliations; this will auto-fix games with the existing problems
-fixed numerous players showing up as free agents in a 2004-05 historical start when they should have been on a team
-the Hall of Fame announcement screen no longer ignores post-game-start championship wins
-"Replace With" now works properly on a farm team when the user is managing its parent has the control lines option on
-adjusted role scores for enforcer, goon, and agitator roles so players who fight frequently will score higher in the first two and lower in the third

-added support for a separate goalie icon with a "goalie" (rather than "player") prefix , e.g. if goalie_chicago_blackhawks_home.png exists, it will be used for the goalie instead of player_chicago_blackhawks_home.png
-sped up player movement towards the bench on a line change
-offensive non-puckhandlers' movement should now be a little more forward-directed during breakouts and in the neutral zone (it had a tendency to to a little too side-to-side, which was creating problems when the puckhandler was usually getting well ahead of his wingers/rushing D)

notes.title: FHM7 Hotfix 7.4.137 Now Available
notes.content:
Unfortunately, a nasty crash bug evaded even the public beta test of the update, so a hotfix is necessary.  But we'd already begun making changes for the next update, some of which were too far along to remove just for a simple hotfix, so there are a few other changes, including one significant one: optional full control of your farm teams' lines.

Changes:
-fixed crash when using the reset button on the filter
-"Control Farm Teams - Lines" now gives the user full control of the lines of all playable farm teams.  It also disables all AI intervention for all farm team lineup/line (not roster) decisons and forces the user to always have a valid lineup for each minor league game - i.e. if you don't have the right number of players dressed, have somebody ineligible in the lineup, have incomplete lines, etc., you get the same error messages he would with with your main team and get sent to the farm team's lines screen to rectify whatever the problem is.  Note that it is not possible to control a farm team's lines if you have assistant control turned on for your own lines.
-auto-qualify will no longer fail occasionally for some players who are assigned to farm teams
-GSAA is now calculated properly in goalies' career stats
-some of the RFA's selected by Seattle in the 20-21 entry draft will no longer give the "match offer" notification when the user attempts to sign them 
-lowered maximum potential of generated players with checking/defensive-type templates
-added a mechanic to limit development of players of approximately NHL third-line potential in their 20's playing in leagues far below their level (will hopefully prevent some of the bloat in 2-2.5 star players in later years of the game)
-Seattle expansion draft changed to 3 goalies + 27 skaters instead of separate F and D numbers (was preventing the team from making enough picks if the final team(s) didn't have players available of the position they needed)
-restored broken function of "Unpredictable" player development status that can increase/decrease potentials of younger players, and made it much more likely to occur to goalies

notes.title: FHM7 Update 7.4.132 Now Available
notes.content:
A new update for FHM7, version 7.4.132, has just been released.

Thanks to everyone who participated in the open beta for this update, we found a number of things that might otherwise have made it past testing and forced a hotfix.  The next update is tentatively targeted for shortly after the NHL trading deadline (April 12), but we may need longer than that to finish some of the additions we're planning.

New features:

-the "Current" database start option is now available with playable league rosters updated as of the end of February
-on July 1 in the league structure editor, you can now use the Import Historical Team option to import any playable team from the historical database and Import Team to do the same from the modern database; the rosters will be the same as in Exhibition mode (the import functions uses the same mechanics.) For historical teams, select the team name (usually the latest one for that team, i.e. if you want the 1984 Winnipeg Jets, choose Arizona, or if you want the 2001 Atlanta Thrashers, choose (non-WHA) Winnipeg
-the 3 World Cup of Hockey tournaments (96, 04, 16) have been added to historical mode
-added new options to the Scouting-Watch List screen: "Clear" (removes all players on the list) and "Clear A" (removes all players currently scouted to the A-level)
-added a checkbox option to the staff filter: "Unemployed"; turning it on filters out all staff who currently have a contract
-changed criteria for some of the December "Player Poll Results Released" news item categories, and added a few new ones: Most Controversial, Most Overrated, Most Underrated, Smartest
-added another section to the scouting report in all modes: for every position on the team that the AI evaluates as a weakness, it will show the top free agents/available players at that position (i.e. all players who are either free agents, contracted to a team in this league and on the trading block, or contracted to a team in a league from which they can be signed directly with no compensation)
-added a Leave Game option to the exhibition game start screen
-if the user is in control of their farm team's staff, they now get an email announcing when their contracts are expiring like they would for the main team's staff
-added Auto-Play option for end of playoffs
-added "Rescale" option (in File-Setup Options) to Hall of Fame section that adjusts the HOF standards to something more appropriate to the length of the top league's schedule; this is intended mainly for custom/historical leagues with very short schedules, whose players would normally have trouble reaching the regular benchmarks
-on the Waiver Draft submission deadline, there is now an option on the league dropdown to return to the submission screen, so it's easier to get back to after navigating away from it while working on your list
-added a new checkbox option to the Filter screen's Misc section, below "Signable": "Realistic Signing Targets", which will filter the list down to players whose league rights are owned by the team, or who are likely (by a very conservative estimate) to be willing to sign with the team.  Note that players who this filter excludes may still be willing to sign, particularly for higher-level leagues.
-if a player has the autoqualify option available on his contract negotiation screen (i.e. in the last year of a contract ending in RFA status), he now also has a right-click option "Autoqualify On" (or Off, as appropriate), that toggles the autoqualify option on/off for him (removing the need to open up the negotiation screen)
-added a checkbox option to Manager Options - Profile: "Reject all international job offers"; this off by default, but if selected, will prevent any international team GM jobs from being offered to the user
-signing players from your junior farm teams will now always be an instant signing once an agreement is reached
-the "Buyout Rights" option for players in junior leagues now costs nothing
-when creating a custom league, the Contract Maximum minimum value is now 35 (was 50) to match the amount League Edit allows; and conversely, league edit allows increasing teams up to 90 teams, to match the initial setup allowing up to 90
-on the contract offer screen, the arrow buttons will now decrease the contract offer in $100 increments once it's at $1000 (had been impossible to go below $1000 before)
-added a position dropdown for the roster, stats, and search screens to filter what's listed by main player position, options are C,LW,RW,LD,RD,G,F,D (as in our editor)

Changes:

-when changing the selected item in the upper area of the world/tem/league menu (national team/tournament, club team, league, etc.) the most frequently-used screen in that category is now opened, e.g. switching teams opens the roster screen for that team (unless the user is already in that area and changes the selection, then it won't change)
-fixed issue that could select the wrong pick order in 2022 and leave Seattle with no picks
-the 17-24 picks in the NHL Draft will no longer reverse there order under some circumstances
-the first round list on the Entry Draft Order email sent the day before the draft and the Draft Lottery screen now show traded picks correctly

2D New Features:

-shootouts and penalty shots are now fully animated
-2D player icons are now moddable. The files need to be added on a team-by-team basis, and go in \graphics\rink_pics and use the usual naming format, i.e. the game will look for files in this format: player_chicago_blackhawks_home.png, then player_chicago_blackhawks_home_1989-2012.png, then player_chicago_blackhawks_home_2014.png (i.e., as the logos work; same thing for away teams.)  The file should be a 60x60 png - however, you should only use the innermost 36x36 (i.e., everything except the outside 12 rows on all sides) for your design and leave the remaining outside squares transparent, otherwise the icons will look overly-large and may overlap the player's uniform number.
-added option (in Start-Settings) to change positioning of player numbers relative to the player icons - they can now be above, above and to the right, or centered on the icon.  If they're not on the icon, the numbers are in black, otherwise they use the previous colouring system
-added hit posts/crossbars

2D Changes:

-adjusted player behaviour during breakaways, particularly for shootouts and penalty shots
-fixed potential crash during breakaways
-rebalanced base goal chances slightly to get overall scoring back to the correct level
-players leaving the ice on a change are no longer ignored when checking for offsides
-decreased 5-on-3 frequency, increased frequency of penalties called on power play teams
-significantly increased tendency of players to shoot at an empty net, particularly when closer to it, also changed method for increasing shooting chance when defending net is empty
-reduced frequency of late-game dump-ins by team that is losing a close game
-made players more likely to try for an immediate change after leaving the penalty box when the open position is one they can't play
-fixed tendency of all defenders to chase puckhandler while his teammates go to the bench on a change
-more work on redistributing hit numbers in a more realistic way (fewer D hitting, more F)
-reduced shot block chances when multiple players are in the shooting lane (still increases the overall chance of a block, but not as much)
-increased scoring chance at extremely short shooting ranges
-several penalty adjustments to decrease number of penalty calls while a power play is underway, during overtime, and in playoff games
-increased fight frequency in preseason games and decresed it during playoffs
-fixed a couple of potential crashes
-sped up player movement to bench during on-the-fly substitutions
-changed icing logic to prevent icing when defenders are clearly in position to reach the puck before it crosses the goal line
-made dump-ins more frequent during line changes
-puckhandler will tend to go to the corner/boards when he's alone in the offensive zone while multiple teammates are changing
-increased chances of altercation turning into a fight
-increased altercation frequency in preseason games and decreased it during playoffs
-decreased tendency of players to pass to the teammate with the highest chemistry with them
-slightly lowered shot-blocking chances
-removed reduction of pass/shoot rating when several playmaker-type players are on the ice together
-further adjustment to hitting frequencies between positions, and made hits more likely nearer to the boards
-made players more likely to choose the best pass target option when under pressure
-changed number of defenders chasing an iced puck from 2 to 1
-increased tendency of defending players to maintain separation from their teammates
-adjusted AI of defencemen on puckhandling team to avoid leaving/staying out of the offensive zone while their team is controlling the puck deep in the zone, particularly during power plays
-player icon will no longer remain in penalty box when penalty ends due to a power play goal being scored
-if a goalie is pulled for an extra skater and the opposite team scores enough goals that they're now leading by 3, the goalie will return to the net
-players on bench now overlap slightly so they're not spread out so widely and the benches don't extend so far down the ice
-re-weighted selection of player blocking a shot when multiple players are in position to do so, so it's not slanted so heavily towards defencemen
-added (small) minimum chance of a fight ensuing when two low-aggression players are in an altercation
-slightly reduced shot accuracy
-slightly increased goal chances for accurate shots
-increased pass target priority for defencemen during power plays
-slightly decreased overall shot frequency
-lowered hit frequency
-corrected error with puckhandler occasionally moving into crease
-fixed potential loop when the game tries to call a penalty on a player heading to the bench on a substitution
-fixed potential loop after dump-ins
-fixed incorrect location on some rebounds

notes.title: Open Public Beta for Next Update
notes.content:
The upcoming update is going to be a very large one, both in terms of new content as well as fixes, so we've decided to run a public beta prior to its release, giving you access to test builds of the new update before the official release.  We're hoping this will let us find the type of issues that have been forcing us to issue post-update hotfixes, allowing us to address those before the final release rather than after.

[b]Please bear in mind, if you opt-in to the beta, that these are test builds and may do unexpected things[/b]; the whole point of the public beta is to find these problems.  We offer no promises that something unpleasant won't happen to any save you use with the beta version, so, if you want to take part with one of your current saved games, it's best to use the "Save Game As" option on the game's File menu to make a new version of the save and use that, so you don't ruin the "good" copy of your save.

Right now we're aiming for a full release of the update sometime the week after next, but that plan could change depending on how long it takes to resolve any issues found in the beta and any new ones that come up.  There will likely be at least one additional public beta version prior to that.

The public beta is only available for the Steam version of the game - Steam makes it ridiculously easy to set one up (under an hour for Sebastian and I the first time we do it, minutes afterward), where a Fastspring beta would require us a full-scale release process from us (most of a day for Malte and Sebastian every time we update the beta), which isn't practical to do.

[b]To join the beta:

1. Right-click on FHM7 in your Steam Library and select Properties
2. Click on "Betas"
3. Under "Enter beta access code to unlock private betas", enter the access code, which is "updatepublicbeta" (no quotes)
4. That should populate the "Select the beta..." box above with the option "public_beta - Public Beta", select that
5. Steam should then automatically update your game.  If it doesn't do that, check your update queue; if it's not in there, exit and restart the Steam client and it should appear.
[/b]
Should you wish to leave the beta, just go back to the Betas page and on the dropdown menu select None.  Steam will then revert you to the current public version of the game.  When the final version of the update is ready, the public beta branch will be updated to that one as well, so there'll be no need to change back to get it.

If you're already one of our internal beta testers, don't join the public beta!  You'll lose access to the beta versions we don't release to the public.

If you find any problems with the beta, particularly fixes that aren't working or unexpected issues arising out of the changes made, continue to report them the usual channels - preferably the tech support forum on our boards, the Steam board, or /r/franchisehockey on Reddit, those get checked daily.  But, when reporting, please mention that you found the problem while using the public beta.

notes.title: FHM7 Hotfix 7.3.113 Now Available
notes.content:
A new hotfix update for Franchise Hockey Manager 7, version 7.3.113, has just been released to fix several critical issues in the 7.3.111 update and an ongoing problem with screen shaking when watching games.

Your existing savegames will be compatible with the updated game; the update should retroactively fix the issues causing the crashes.

Changes:
-fixed display problem in 2D match engine that was causing screen to shake at lower game resolutions
-fixed crash in February related to Austrian league playoffs
-fixed crash related to reverting German league to its normal structure in 21-22; the effects of this problem could be delayed, leading to crashes at various times in 21-22 or later seasons
-fixed issue that was creating scheduled games in non-playable leagues, leading to instability
-related issue to the above one with non-playable teams getting team stats (this is the one exception to the retroactive fixes - if you have a save in 20-21 with a league that has relegation set to playable but have the level below it, when that level can be set to playable, set to nonplayable, a promoted team from the second level will add its point totals from 20-21 to 21-22, so it's highly likely they'll win the top-level league's regular season easily)
-fixed potential waiver draft crash

notes.title: FHM7 Update 7.2.105 Now Available
notes.content:
The first full post-release update for FHM7, version 7.2.105, has just been released.

Your existing savegames will be compatible with the updated game, but some of the update's fixes may not retroactively correct certain problems in existing saves.

The change list for this update was somewhat limited by the timeframe involved; for the most part, the changes are things that could be dealt with and tested in a few days, while leaving a couple of days' safety margin before Christmas to deal with any serious, unanticipated issues that might arise.  We did manage to take care of quite a few things, though, so we should be in good shape post-holiday to continue fixing outstanding issues, adding new things to the 2D engine, and begin adding new content to the game.

Speaking of which, now that the NHL has announced the format and dates for the upcoming season, we'll start moving ahead with our plans for the "realistic" starting option for 2020-21 season, with the shorter schedules, realignments, and so on.  We're hoping to have this ready around the time of opening night, give or take a few days.  We should be able to implement most of what the NHL has announced, although we'll probably need to move some dates to match our July 1 season start - with the Stanley Cup scheduled for mid-July, we may just wind up having the in-game start about a month earlier to make everything fit.  Some of the reported roster rules, like requiring the teams to carry 3 goalies, may also need to be adjusted to keep the roster AI from behaving oddly.

[b]
2D Engine Changes:[/b]

-modding the 2D rink for individual teams is now possible: the modded image should have the format rink_team_name.png (e.g. rink_vancouver_canucks.png) and be placed in the \graphics\rink_pics folder of a quickstart or individual save. The image needs to match playfield_0.png precisely in terms of dimensions (2880 x 1344) and the location of on-ice markings, or you'll see players doing things like skating off the ice, apparent offsides not being called, etc.
-fixed the bug that would show the same player being named on every penalty called after an injury occurred
-after switching goalies manually, the original goalie's icon will no longer remain on the ice
-added play-by-play text during shootouts - we're having some issues with the shootout animation at the moment, which will take a little longer to resolve, but right now if you click the Quick button during the shootout it'll advance through each shot, showing you the play-by-play of what happened, and the shootout score will be displayed on the scoreboard
-fixed incidence of brief flickering of players near centre ice when they leave the ice on a line change during play
-slightly slowed players' speed when moving to the bench during line changes
-made the colour of the clock-related numbers (period, clock, penalty clock) slightly different than the score numbers
-fewer players will now get ejected from faceoffs
-raised overall player speed slightly
-the fatigue requirement for lines to get changed before a faceoff was dropped a bit, so there should be more pre-faceoff line changes
-increased speed of dump-ins
-slightly increased fighting/roughing frequency
-increased frequency of icings, offsides, pucks leaving the ice, and dump-ins
-made players less likely to make risky passes on their own side of the ice and in their defensive zone in particular
-several adjustments to pass targeting and the default behaviour of some tactical roles, which were leading to excessive shots for some players

[b]Other Changes:[/b]

-the game will now ignore Windows display scaling settings and show FHM in normal size, regardless of what screen scaling Windows is using
-the extra delay on the player popups is gone
-fixed potential crash in late June
-fixed draft crash in custom leagues with only 2 teams
-corrected broken trading deadline in 20-21 for Liiga and National League in standard games
-fixed crash when trying to sign free agents as a German team
-fixed error in 2010 Olympics that could place a team in multiple places, leading to a crash
-fixed potential crash while simming games with classic engine
-fixed Steam Workshop popup being transparent, making it difficult to read
-scouting for WHL/OHL/QMJHL teams should now properly cover prospects for those leagues
-assitant-run scouting for human teams should choose its top regional priority correctly now
-added a dropdown filter to league-scouting-hire scouts, with the 5 Scouting Coverage maps as options (they filter the list to scouts from that area)
-in custom games, players in leagues that a major league doesn't draft from now have their rights set to free for that league, so they can be signed once they're the appropriate age, rather than not being able to go anywhere after their junior career ends
-adjusted top goalie and MVP award calculations
-fixed a bug in the MVP award nominations that would give a nomination to a player who wasn't in the top 3
-captain status will now be recorded in the player career stats for seasons after the game starts
-added playoff versions of team stats.csv and boxscore csv's to the CSV export should be added, as should a playoff version of the boxscore csv's (or include them in the existing boxscore csv's)
-the Goalie Positioning rating on the filter will now work properly, and the skater Positioning filter won't show goalies
-the award ceremony should now appear properly occurring in saves imported from FHM6
-the AI in non-junior leagues will no longer put players on the trading block if their age is <21 (was lowering their trade value, which made it easier to steal good prospects from the AI teams)
-fixed problem where "AI assign scouts" would place regional priorities from one map into another's list, or blank lines on the list
-all NHL RFA's at the start of a new game should now be willing to negotiate with their teams, instead of behaving as it they had already broken off negotiations
-using "Save As" in a historical random debut game will no longer fail to copy some random debut data, leading to extremely small draft classes
-fixed issue with NHL awards ceremony in some historical seasons being before the nominations, leading to all awards being given to a default player
-when starting a Custom Game with any of the NHL options, the team rivalry data no longer gets randomized
-in a Custom Game with the NHL+AHL(+CHL) options, the AHL and CHL teams no longer have 2-5 copies of each staff member
-changing the number of draft rounds in a historical game will no longer result in all non-expansion teams losing their draft picks for that season
-fixed a couple of issues that were restricting NHL teams' ability to reduce cap total when in cap trouble, leading to odd moves (most commonly seen with Tampa Bay in standard games, their salary structure was a perfect fit for a situation that made them unable to reduce their cap hit via trades, leading to odd player movement and releases)
-reduced excessive usage of the Perimeter Shooter tactical role
-added options to the NHL options in custom games to use the initial draft for the NHL and play the NHL, etc. setups with fictional players
-Awards Announcements no longer disappear after the first season in a custom NHL-only game
-attempting to edit a non-active team (found via the team search) will no longer crash the game
-small data update, a few errors fixed and some moves updated (NHL moves are as of December 20)

notes.title: FHM7 Hotfix, Version 7.1.101, Now Available
notes.content:
A new hotfix update for Franchise Hockey Manager 7, version 7.1.101, has just been released to fix a couple of critical issues with the release version of the game.

Changes:

-fixed crash on some systems when trying to start a new game

-fixed crash when trying to click-and-drag scouts in the Fastspring version; instead of clicking-and-dragging, right-click on the scout's name and select the role you want to give him
